notes.title: Visual Update Now Live
notes.notes:
You asked for it, here it is :)

Today we're celebrating the 1 year anniversary of Brick Odyssey release with a graphic overhaul. To mark this special occasion, we also wanted to offer a 20% discount on the game.


Special thanks to Pixuso, the artist behind all the new art, don't hesitate to join the Brick Odyssey Discord Server to let him know how much you like the new look!

We hope you appreciate all the improvements, the updates also comes with a few fixes and balance changes (complete patch note below).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362515/3a4d45882ebfa0bd5556c6f5b62be6bd909b25a4.png

Also note that the previous version will remain accessible in a Nostalgia Branch, in case some of you ever get curious to compare the old esthetic to the new one. (Can be accessed through Steam Beta Participation menu)


What's next?
In the coming days we're going to look closely at all the feedback and bugs or balance issues that might require some adjustments.

We have a few concept ideas for possible new content/heroes in the future (design challenge: how would you transcribe the typical Druid or Necromancer mechanics to a brick-breaking gameplay? It's okay if you have no idea, because we do ;)) but first we need to assess the reception of the visual update before making big decisions about where to direct our attention next.



Thanks everyone for supporting the game, you made this update possible :)



Complete Patch Notes: 

Complete overhaul of the visuals

New Ranger relic replacing the Composite Bow: Practice Target - A moving target appears at the top of the board, hitting it with arrows increase damage by 1 for the duration of the fight.

Ranger projectile speed increased from 6 to 7

5 coin bricks will now spawn in every fight, they grant 2 gold when destroyed.
An extra coin brick will spawn after reaching world 2 & 3
Post-fight gold gains slightly reduced in consequence

Gold gained by selling a chest reduced from 50 to 40
Cost of buying relics in shops reduced by 10-16 gold

Added a dps meter, displaying your average dps during the previous 5 second

Added Post-fight combat report

Ancient Turtle: The Turtle special brick now changes the turtle state, focring it in or out of cover. (Prevents a possible stuck issue and slightly changes the dynamic of the fight)

Slightly changed the central bricks in the soul-eater fight to prevent the soulball getting stuck there

Slightly reduced the hp of Worlds 2 & 3 normal enemies

Rocket bricks spawns reduced from 5 rockets to 4

Added a new mysterious swamp event

Rainbow in a Bottle relic removed for now

Reduced Powder Keg speed boost to multiballs

Fixed incorrect amount of gold showing up after a fight in higher StormLevel

Improved projectile hitbox (queenbee)

Made corrections to the spanish localisation

notes.title: Announcing the Visual Update anniversary release
notes.notes:
The Visual Update is set to go live on the 25th of January, marking the first year anniversary of the game release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362515/42b7abd2837de114f69f05f2f0c4c14192c7dfb6.gif
Not only the game will look much better, some other small changes will also be included such as:

Coin Bricks
Gling gling gling, that's the sound of gold dropping into your pockets.
Very satisfying and a good way to make early game more engaging, every fight now start with 5 Coin Bricks on the board that the player has to destroy to collect extra gold. 
Resets won't respawn already destroyed Coin Bricks, but they do shuffle the position of remaining ones.

DPS Meter
Make the numbers go high. Your current dps is now shown on the combat interface (average damage per second over the last 5 seconds).
The post-fight screen now also show a Combat Report, with various information such as the overall dps, healing done and damage taken.

Clash with the Storm
An end-game challenge starting on Storm Level 3+
Measure your build efficiency in a dps-race against what is basically a dummy target. You get a limited amount of time to deal as much damage as you can.
Your total amount of damage and best score with each hero is saved. Let's see which one of you will get the highest one.

Other Changes
Several other small changes and balance adjustments have been made, such as the Ranger getting a new heroic relic to replace his Composite Bow, a new bar filling up to show when the player is about to get confused, and a few new relics getting added


I'll leave you with a few more images preview of the incoming changes :)
Mac,

notes.title: Engineer Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, new update just went live!
This one introduce lots of new mechanics.

First a new Hero of course: The Engineer, I already mentionned that this one was inspired by feedback from the community. Some people mentionned how it would be fun to increase the feeling of power the players get, and some also mentionned that they would like a more casual game mode.

The Engineer is the incarnation of that: He is specialized in destroying bricks, tons of bricks. But to compensate that his damage output is lowered, and many effects that are triggered by brick destructions are nerfed on him (like the Bottled Rainbow for exemple).
His gameplay is way simpler than the other heroes you can unlock. He starts with a weak turret on his paddle and throughout each fights he gets the opportunity to upgrade it. 
There's 4 different upgrades each with 3 upgrade levels. Every 6 seconds you get to choose between 2 possible upgrades. So you will still have some important choices to make, but the hero is way less punitive than what the Elementalist or the Shade can be.
An upgraded turret will have a chance to trigger special attacks when its firing (it's not actually random, it counts the number of shots and trigger an effect every X shots depending on the upgrade)
He also has a shield upgrade, that blocks projectiles and transform them into healing. So he get a bit of sustain out of that :)

Secondly: New Challenges. There's now 11 challenges to complete, each with a new relic to unlock as a reward (or extra rerolls). The first time you complete a challenge you will instantly receive its relic reward for your run, and the relic will have a chance to appear in all future runs. 
Challenges also save the highest StormLevel in which they were completed, so good luck completing them all on Storm15. (I personally wasn't yet able to beat the game with only one upgrade on Storm15. Don't hesitate to send a video if you make it! ^^)
This is a great way to add additional objectives. And I plan to keeping adding some more in the future.

With the number of available relics increasing, I felt it was important to not dilute the pool too much, so the players now get an option to Reroll Relics, once per run at first, but completing some challenges will incrase this number. This is to make sure you can still get the relics you want for the build of your dreams, even with more and more relics being added to the game.


What's next for the future: 
I have ideas for new heroes, new relics and new challenges of course, even maybe new bricks. So yeah, you can expect some more content to be added. But all these ideas are only at the concept stage so it might take quite a bit of time. I will only add new heroes if I have a solid design and the concepts I have in mind right now aren't solid enough yet ^^
Some players also mentionned they'd like longer runs. I'll keep that in mind, I might have some ideas. I'm not sure if adding an extra zone is the best solution (although I'd love a desert themed area), because I feel like the current 30-45minute per run is a pretty good spot. But let me know what you think about that specific point. I'm very interested.
I'm easy to reach on Discord and Twitter, and I love receiving all your feedback!

Thanks everyone for the encouragements and nice comments. I hope you like the new update!

notes.title: Balance Changes and Small Fixes - Patch Note
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! And welcome to all the new players.
I've been working hard on the next update. The new hero design is looking promising and I'm sure you'll enjoy it. It still need a bit more work and balancing done but it should hopefully be ready in a week or so.
Next update will also contain a bunch of new challenges, each with a new unlockable relic. As always I try to make sure the relics have interesting design, don't hestiate to join the Discord if you want to make suggestions. It's always fun to see what ideas the community can come up with.

In the meantime:
I've also been fixing bugs and doing some small balance changes. I wasn't expecting to patch the game until the next update is ready, but I feel like the amount of changes made and their importance now justify a small weekly update.

This patch also include one new challenge to help you with the wait. I'm sure this challenges will be unpopular, but it was just too funny to watch a certain streamer having his ball go wild and bounce from one curse to an other against the Cursed One. Who needs maxHp anyway!
(The reward for the Hydra challenge has been changed, and its previous reward is now the reward for the new challenge, sorry for the inconsistent change but it just makes so much more chance thematically to have it that way.)


I wanted to talk a bit about the most important balance change of the update:
The Primal Essence fight got his brick layout slightly changed. With the addition of the Rocket Brick in the previous update the fight got indirectly harder, and it would more often result in an unccontrollable chain reaction.
To counteract this I added more bricks on the board and increased the overall hardness of the present bricks, the fight should now be a bit easier. It will get tweaked some more if needed.

For anyone curious I'll take this opportunity to talk about the Primal Essence and how the fight works, because I can't put so much info in the in-game fight description:
This Elite has a list of spells, and every time an upgraded brick is destroyed the Primal will use a spell that depends on the brick's upgrade.
So destroying a pyrobrick will always trigger the vertical fireballs attack, destroying a poison brick will always trigger a confusion, etc.
All the offensive spells of the Primal Essence are triggered by bricks that are upgraded to destroy other bricks (Pyro, Explo, Multi, Rocket) so watch out about those and try to slow down the fight so it doesn't start a chain reaction. Good Luck!
If you are interested in these kind of details, don't hesitate to come talk about it on the Discord. I love talking about the intricate parts of the game design but I always tend to cut it short to avoid getting too nerdy with explanations ^^
But I'm happy to talk about it and share any info you might be interested in.


Here's the complete list of changes:

Challenges will now always give their relic reward on first time completion.

This update brings in a fun new brick. The destructive Rocket Brick, brings in the potential for some very satisfying chain reactions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362515/3d4a5fc78fc5f172ab20f070596cb922e9c0c6ba.gif

I know how much we all like the Hydra (wink), but World1 now also has a chance of having an alternate boss. 
The Goblin Warchief has a much lower amount of bricks on the board, upgrading your Reset Threshold might come in handy against this one!

Struggling to get your Reset Threshold as high as you would like? Well you may now choose to increase it instead of picking a relic after an Elite Fight or Chest Event. 
Note that choosing to increase the Reset Threshold will remove one of the 3 offered relics from the relic pool. So you don't need to pick a relic you don't like just to increase your chances of a better one showing up next time.

This patch also include a few fix and balance changes, special thanks to TimeToGrind who extensively tested out the Elementalist on stream, it helped a lot to balance some quirks.
He's super nice and uploaded several videos showcasing the potential of the hero, so don't hesitate to check out his channel. https://www.youtube.com/@TimeToGrind

What's coming next?
I'm happy with all the content recently added, there will be more (I have plans for a new destructive hero) but for now I will focus a bit more on the marketing aspect.
I haven't done much marketing before the release, and I think the game could really benefit from getting some extra attention/reviews.
If you know content creators that could be interested in trying out the game, don't hesitate to contact me on Twitter or Discord.
The game could also use a new trailer, for that I need to record gameplay clips and I thought what a better way to do it than doing it live on Twitch. So I'll most likely be streaming some gameplay in the coming week, feel free to join in and have a chat, ask questions, give feedback, help clip stuff. It's gonna be fun :)
I'll announce the date when I go live on twitter/discord, if you're interested you can already follow me there: https://www.twitch.tv/macmorgan_

I want to thank everybody for playing the game, giving some great feedback and encouraging comments, I hope you appreciate the new update!

notes.title: A Mysterious New Hero Has Arrived - The Shade Update is Live!
notes.notes:
The game needed a rogue archetype, and I'm very happy with how this design turned out. 
What does rogues typically do?
Backstab their enemies, create subtle combos, move around with high mobility, be vulnerable in-between huge bursts of damage.
The Shade is the incarnation of all those mechanics in a block-breaking form.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43362515/addc48cb1f5a14a4d8988f4d9b6740698d7d5438.gif

This hero can be pretty much all or nothing, but it brings a very satisfying new approach to the gameplay. Experienced players will certainly enjoy theorycrafting new builds with this one.


This update also brings a lot of other changes: 

A new mechanic: the ball gets a boost of speed after a forced ejection off the paddle. The first bounce will deal double damage and pierce through weaker bricks. Raising the skill cap just a bit higher.

A new poison brick: providing a new way to scale damage.

3 new relics.

I also made some small changes to make the game more beginner-friendly: a lot of beginners got stuck in a situation where they had to heal after every fight, preventing them from upgrading their deck and thus snowballing into needing more heals.
To counteract this I've made some small changes to the early Storm Levels. The hero now has a bit more hp and automatically heals 20hp at the end of every fight. This perk gets removed at Storm Level 3.
Chests events now also offer a brickupgrade/rest option just as any other events. These changes should help players to stay ahead of the difficulty curve and hopefully give beginners more room to experiment and find their bearings.
Also don't hesitate to join the discord and ask for help if you're struggling, remember that all bosses have their weakness.

Localisation: The german translation has been updated to be vastly improved.
Special thanks to Lisa Kürtzen ( https://www.linkedin.com/in/lisa-k%C3%BCrten-1b8ba825a/ ) for offering to help with that. She did an amazing job.
If you want to help or provide feedback on other localisation, once again -> Discord

What is coming next: I have ideas for fun new bricks and heroes, but these might take a bit longer to implement. Don't expect big updates like this one to come every week.
I also want to add a new boss to World1, the reason I haven't done it yet is because I really like the Hydra fight, I think it's pretty iconic, and I couldn't come up with a design that could compete with this one.
Buuuuut I might have an interesting idea now, I'll test it out.
I also keep improving the art style, step by step, you might already notice some changes in this update ;)

I hope you'll like it! I also want to thank everyone who sent kind words/reviews/feedback, it's great to see players understanding and appreciating the game and it is a huge source of motivation and confidence.


Here's the complete list of changes:

New Hero : Shade

New Mechanic : Forced ejection heavy attack

New Brick : Poison Brick

Tanto
Sushi
Hemlock


The hero receives a free 20hp heal after every fight

notes.title: Crash Hotfix +small balance changes
notes.notes:
Quick fix to a situation with some relics that could cause a crash. There's also a couple balance changes in this update. 
Making good progress on the new hero! Also working on new bricks, relics, and improving the Paladin appearence.

Detailed changes: 

-----

Armorsmith hp upgrade increased from 15 to 20

Goblin Siege Engine projectiles are now slightly more spread out

Fixed a possible crash with the cornucopia

notes.title: Update 1.02 - Mouse Control Is Back
notes.notes:
Mouse Control is back.
It was removed because it seemed not so popular and it caused small compatibility issues with the controllers.
These issues should be fixed now, please contact me if you encounter any crashs or other issues, Discord is the quickest way to reach me, but Twitter or e-mail also work.

Here's the complete list of changes:

-------

Mouse Control can be activated from the option menu.

Arrow Keys can now be used to navigate the game by default

New design for the paladin paddle (hitbox didn't change. WIP, the paladin is also getting redesigned)

Paladin's blessings shouldn't appear so close to the side walls anymore

Cursed One easy mode: Cursed Bricks are now reinforced

Goblin Siege Engine damage reduced from 20/25 to 15/20

Fixed the Cultist Ritual tooltip stating 15seconds instead of 12

Small novelty in the hero selection menu for players who unlocked the secret achievement

notes.title: Update 1.01 - More default Relics
notes.notes:
The amount of available relics for new players seemed a bit too low, resulting in the same relics appearing too often. As a quick fix I've reduced the maximum progression level to 10, and added 5 of the previously unlockable relics to the default list.
There are a lot of cool relics to unlock, but it felt like it was taking too long for new players to see them. Hopefully this change will bring more variety for new players.

There's a few other changes in this update, here's the complete list:

-----

Maximum progression level reduced to 10, in order to increase the amount of relics available in the starting pool
Progression xp received slightly reduced

Ancient Turtle : Shell Brick is now harder

Visual Improvements

Shade presence increased

notes.title: Pre-Release Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The game is getting ready for the release! This is most likely the biggest patch before the 25th.
It contains balance changes and important fixes.
Here's the detailed list of changes:

-Elementalist:
Elemental Paddles will now collapse when moving against a side wall
FFW damage ratio increased from 0.5 to 0.65
Fire Codex damage increased from 3 to 4

-Crystalline Amalgam:
Renamed to Crystal Amalgam
Blue Crystal damage increased from 10 to 15

-Frog King:
Now only has an enrage mechanic in hard mode
Heal reduced from 200/450 to 150/300

-Cursed One:
Cursed brick amount reduced from 10 to 8

Scavenging for gold after a fight now grants a bit more gold in earlier fights and a bit less in later ones

-Controller:
Fixed manual recall keybinds
Fixed a possible crash in the post-fight menu
Fixed being able to change the Storm Level during transition

Various Visual Improvements

notes.title: Small Beta Update - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This update fixes a possible crash with the new confusion effect and also introduce a manual reset option in case you don't like the initial brick layout. I feel like bad rng wasn't too much of an issue but this adds an extra layer of protection against it (and a bit of strategic planning).
As always, feedback is appreciated. More mechanics revolving around this system might be added in the future.

Here's the detailed patch note:

You now have the option to manually reset the initial brick layout once before the start of every fight

Ancient Turtle damage reduced from 30 to 15
Ancient Turtle attack cooldown reduced from 5sec to 3sec

Fixed a confusion related crash

One new event in the swamp (Fruit)

Progression Level is now displayed in the hero selection menu

notes.title: 3 New Elites - Patch Note
notes.notes:
Getting ready for the release! 
A new elite has been added to each world. The first one is a basic introduction to enemy projectiles, the second one revolves around good recall usage, and the third one does different things depending on the player build. Let me know how they feel :)

Here's the complete list of changes, that you might want to read thoroughly:

3 New Elite Fights, one for each World

Added one new secret achievement

Crystalline Amalgam now causes confusion after a crystal is destroyed
Also slightly changed his brick layout
Increased the Red Crystal reload time by half a second

Explosions no longer affects the direction of nearby balls, but still gives a movespeed increase
Explosions also increase the speed of the Elemental Ball now (wasn't the case previously)
Decreased Elemental Ball friction (takes longer than other balls to slow down to its base move speed)

Storm Level can be turned on/off by clicking the storm symbol in the hero selection menu

World Map can now be scrolled in the background when an upgrade menu is on screen

Moved the middle tree in the starter fight one pixel to the left for shady reasons

Various visual improvements

various visuals improvements

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Brick Odyssey will be released on January 25th, in exactly 3 weeks.

I am currently working on adding new boss and elite fights to the game. Beta updates will be a bit more sparse for the moment because designing and balancing those enemies is quite time consuming.

If you want to know more about the game development or have some comments to share with me, you are very welcome to join the Discord. 

A huge thanks for all the positive feedback and encouragements, it really helps to see some hype about the game!
